name: kea-gauntlet
description: Self-contained certification gauntlet for the untitled kea game. bash gauntlet/verify/gate.sh certifies; no chat required.
comment-type: NO "type":"module" ON PURPOSE. The nine batteries and the shared rig are CommonJS .js files using require(); flipping the package to ESM would break all of them at once. The ported game is an explicit .mjs instead, which is unambiguous under either setting. See REPLAT.md P1.
